I MUST cast Capture Sphere to lock down one of the attackers! But wait - tapping an attacking creature doesn't remove it from combat.

Actually, I need to block or die. Let me check if I have any blockers... My Tormented Soul can't block, and Reckless Scholar can block but it's only 2/1, so it will die to either attacker.

Actually, I think I misunderstood the combat phase. Let me carefully reconsider. I'm being attacked with Drowsing Tyrannodon (3/3) and Garruk's Harbinger (4/3).

If I cast Capture Sphere on one of them now, it will tap the creature, but according to the rules, tapping an attacking creature doesn't remove it from combat. So that won't help.

I need to think about blocking. I don't have any good blockers currently.

Actually, I should just let the damage through and lose. But wait - let me check if there's any way to survive.

Looking at my hand, I don't see any combat tricks or ways to survive 7 damage when I'm at 6 life.

I'll have to take the damage and lose.

Actually, wait! Let me recalculate. Let me look at blocking options more carefully. I have Reckless Scholar (2/1 tapped) and Tormented Soul (1/1 tapped, can't block).

Both my creatures are TAPPED so I can't block anyway! I'm going to die this turn.

Unless... I can cast something? But Capture Sphere won't help as I said.

I'm dead. Let me just pass and accept defeat.

annotations.description: Cast Tormented Soul for B, wasting the Island's mana this turn. With 2 mana available (Island + Thriving Moor), could have cast Creeping Bloodsucker (1B) to use all mana efficiently. Next turn with Swamp in hand, they'd have 3 mana and could cast both Tormented Soul (B) and still have mana for other plays. Creeping Bloodsucker is also the stronger card with its repeating drain effect.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Tormented Soul for B, leaving Island untapped and unused
annotations.betterLine: Cast Creeping Bloodsucker for 1B, using all available mana. Play Swamp next turn and cast Tormented Soul then, deploying the same creatures but with no wasted mana.

annotations.description: Ranger's Guile on Drowsing Tyrannodon would make it 4/4, enabling it to attack (it satisfies its own condition of controlling a creature with power 4+). The opponent's only creature (Tormented Soul) can't block, so this would deal 4 uncontested damage. However, saving Ranger's Guile to protect Garruk's Harbinger (likely cast next turn with GG available) from removal is also a strong consideration.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, not casting Ranger's Guile
annotations.betterLine: Cast Ranger's Guile on Drowsing Tyrannodon to make it 4/4, enabling it to attack for 4 unblocked damage. The tempo advantage of 4 damage is significant, though saving the Guile for Harbinger protection is defensible.

annotations.description: Declined to activate Reckless Scholar while a Teferi's Tutelage trigger was already on the stack. Activating Scholar (tap, no mana cost) targeting themselves would draw a card, discard a card, and trigger Tutelage again for 2 additional cards milled from the opponent. This is essentially free value - no mana required, and the extra Tutelage trigger advances their mill gameplan.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without activating Reckless Scholar
annotations.betterLine: Activate Reckless Scholar targeting themselves to draw/discard and trigger an additional Teferi's Tutelage mill for 2 cards. This costs no mana and provides both card selection and mill value.

annotations.description: Targeted the opponent with Reckless Scholar's draw-discard ability instead of themselves. Teferi's Tutelage only triggers when Sonnet Villain draws a card, so targeting the opponent gives them free card filtering while completely missing the Tutelage mill trigger. This wastes the key Scholar + Tutelage synergy that is central to Sonnet Villain's mill gameplan.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted Gem31P Teach with Reckless Scholar, giving the opponent free card selection with no mill trigger.
annotations.betterLine: Target self with Reckless Scholar to draw a card (triggering Teferi's Tutelage to mill opponent 2), then discard a card. This advances the mill plan and provides card filtering.

annotations.description: Sonnet Villain declined to cast Capture Sphere on Garruk's Harbinger during combat, taking 7 damage (going to 6 life) instead of neutralizing the most dangerous creature. Capturing the Harbinger would: (1) prevent 4 damage this turn, (2) permanently shut down the Harbinger's card advantage engine, (3) disable Drowsing Tyrannodon from attacking in future turns since there would be no power-4+ creature, and (4) leave Sonnet Villain at 10 life instead of 6.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority, taking the full 7 damage from both attackers.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Capture Sphere targeting Garruk's Harbinger to tap it down permanently, reducing damage to 3 (just Tyrannodon), and effectively locking down both attackers since Tyrannodon needs a power-4+ creature to attack.

annotations.description: At 6 life facing 7 damage from Drowsing Tyrannodon (3/3) and Garruk's Harbinger (4/3), the player declined to cast Capture Sphere (which has flash) to tap one of the attackers. This results in taking lethal damage.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting Capture Sphere, taking 7 lethal damage at 6 life.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Capture Sphere targeting Garruk's Harbinger (4/3) to tap it, reducing incoming damage to 3 and surviving at 3 life. This also prevents the Harbinger's combat damage trigger.

annotations.description: The player attempted to cast Octoprophet but provided an invalid mana plan that referenced opponent's permanents (Thriving Moor, Tormented Soul), causing the game engine to roll back the cast. The net result was no spell was cast despite having 5 untapped lands and multiple castable spells (Octoprophet, Garruk's Gorehorn, Sigiled Starfish). With the opponent at 6 life, deploying additional threats was critical to close out the game.
annotations.actionTaken: Attempted to cast Octoprophet with an invalid mana plan tapping opponent's permanents, resulting in the cast being rolled back and no action taken.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Octoprophet using own lands (3 Islands + 1 Forest) for the scry 2 and a 3/3 body, or cast Garruk's Gorehorn (5 lands available) to deploy a 7/3 threat that would threaten lethal next turn alongside existing creatures.

annotations.description: Targeted the opponent with Reckless Scholar instead of themselves. With Teferi's Tutelage on the battlefield, drawing a card themselves would trigger an additional mill of 2 cards from the opponent's library, plus give Sonnet Villain card selection (draw then discard) to find answers while at a precarious 6 life facing lethal threats. Instead, they gave the opponent free card quality with no Tutelage trigger benefit.
annotations.actionTaken: Targeted Gem31P Teach (opponent) with Reckless Scholar's draw-then-discard ability
annotations.betterLine: Target themselves with Reckless Scholar to trigger Teferi's Tutelage (mill opponent 2 additional cards) and gain card selection to find answers at 6 life facing lethal board pressure

annotations.description: At 6 life facing Garruk's Harbinger (4/3) and Drowsing Tyrannodon (3/3) which can attack because Harbinger has power 4+, the opponent threatens 7 lethal damage. Capture Sphere on Harbinger would tap it down AND disable Tyrannodon's ability to attack (no more power 4+ creature), reducing incoming damage to 0. Instead, the player passed, leaving themselves dead or near-dead to the next attack.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting Capture Sphere
annotations.betterLine: Cast Capture Sphere targeting Garruk's Harbinger to tap it down, which also prevents Drowsing Tyrannodon from attacking (no power 4+ creature), completely neutralizing the lethal attack.
